description_zh: Zoox 自动驾驶车辆在车道4直行，右侧相邻车道前方一辆车为绕过骑行者突然向左变道切入，与 Zoox 车辆发生侧碰。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomous mode was traveling in lane 4 on southwest-bound Harrison Street...
Vehicle 2, traveling in the same direction ahead of the Zoox vehicle in the right adjacent lane (lane 5), was attempting to go around a cyclist...
Vehicle 2 then swerved left into lane 4 across the path of the Zoox vehicle and the driver-side quarter panel on Vehicle 2 contacted the passenger-side fender and front door of the Zoox vehicle.
evidence.reason: 双方均为移动车辆，存在明确的侧向切入交互，且 ego 直行具有测试价值，现有词汇表可表达。
